note: Adapted from the species description of Chhotani (1997), originally in English; the alate is recorded as unknown, so that section is not included; synonymy lists, including three synonyms, figure numbers, locality and distribution records are omitted.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Soldier head capsule subrectangular, width slightly more than three-quarters of the length to the mandibular base, mandibles about three-quarters of the head length, left mandible strongly twisted; total length 4.00–5.00 mm. Worker head capsule subcircular, antennae 13–14-segmented, total length 3.25–4.00 mm. Alate not described.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule pale yellow, frontal gland area milk-white; antennae, legs and body milk-white; left mandible nearly black, right mandible reddish black; head rather densely setose, body densely setose; total length 4.00–5.00. Head capsule subrectangular, sides nearly straight, width slightly more than three-quarters of the length to the mandibular base (length to mandibular base 1.40–1.80, maximum width 0.90–1.03, ratio of width to length 0.75–0.85); frontal projection weak, frons steeply inclined anteriorly and slightly tilted backward in profile; coronal suture extending from the posterior margin to one-third to one-half of the head length. Fontanelle small, below the frontal projection; frontal gland variable in size. Antennae 14-segmented, segment 3 generally shorter than segment 2 and clavate, segment 4 generally shortest. Labrum asymmetrical, sides convex (length 0.25–0.33, width 0.20–0.25), anterior margin deeply incurved, anterolateral angles sharp and projecting forward. Mandibles asymmetrical and nearly equal in length, shorter than the head and about three-quarters of its length (left 1.10–1.35, right 1.15–1.35, ratio of left mandible length to head length 0.750–0.819). Left mandible strongly twisted, with an incurved beak apically, the inner margin strongly rounded below the apex, very broad at the middle of the twist. Right mandible blade-like, with a long incurved apical part; outer margin of the anterior half weakly incurved, inner margin weakly incurved near the middle. Postmentum clavate, waist below the middle (length 0.70–0.85, maximum width 0.28–0.33, waist width 0.10–0.15). Pronotum strongly saddle-shaped, anterior and posterior margins weakly concave (length 0.25–0.28, maximum width 0.55–0.60). Legs slender and setose, tibial apical spurs 3:2:2; tarsus 4-segmented; abdomen elongate and setose, cerci 2-segmented, without styli.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head, antennae and labrum pale yellow; head and body densely setose; total length 3.25–4.00. Head capsule subcircular, sides weakly narrowed posteriorly (length to labral apex 1.05–1.18, length to mandibular base 0.60–0.78, maximum width 0.75–0.88). Frontal plate oval to subcircular. Antennae 13–14-segmented; when 13-segmented segment 3 is divided, when 14-segmented segments 3 and 4 are short and segment 3 slightly longer than segment 4. Postclypeus arched, slightly less than half as long as wide (length 0.16–0.18, width 0.45–0.50). Pronotum strongly saddle-shaped, anterior margin weakly concave (length 0.13–0.20, maximum width 0.40–0.55).
